Both used DDA acquisition.

scope: SF3B1 duplicate pull-down samples were either digested in-solution after glycine elution at pH 2.3 and neutralization, or digested on-beads.

A separate SILAC phosphoproteomics experiment was performed using Arg10 and Lys8 heavy isotopes to compare DMSO vs DRB treatment.

TiO2 phosphopeptide enrichment, ERLIC chromatography, and LC–MS/MS
differential: Normalized heavy-to-light ratios were log2 transformed for statistical analyses.

all N-terminal residues to be acetylated (+42,0106, dynamically added)
Phospho (STY) was selected as a variable modification
